observation: Weighting 198 lens, front-perimeter, and back-perimeter edges produced a visibly sharper result but 48 Bevel-stage and 192 post-SubD non-manifold edges.
root_cause: Weighted bevel was applied across incompatible front transitions and the extraordinary back quad-star cap. Width probes from 0.028 down to 0.004 did not change the defect count, proving scope rather than width was the cause.
repair: A scope probe showed lens-only weighting (144 edges) remained closed and manifold before and after SubD; front-only and back-only weighting failed. Keep weighted bevel on lens rings and use closer authored support loops for the shell perimeter.
